name: Post-Apocalyptic
description: Weathered infrastructure and adapted settlements after widespread abandonment. Entries describe places without requiring conflict, injury or extra occupants.
entries: overgrown motorway interchange with vines across concrete pillars
rooftop garden above an abandoned office block
railway carriage converted into a shelter beside disused tracks
dry reservoir with exposed steps and a cracked intake tower
market assembled from salvaged shipping containers
abandoned shopping center with trees growing through roof openings
collapsed parking structure with a clear lower access lane
solar workshop assembled inside an old service station
flooded street with raised wooden walkways between buildings
walled community garden within a former sports ground
sand-buried station with only its upper platform exposed
rusting ferry terminal converted into a storage depot
greenhouse built from mismatched salvaged window frames
empty industrial yard with rainwater tanks beside a sheltered bay
old school hall adapted into a communal repair workshop
radio tower compound with patched antenna cables
disused canal lock with planted terraces along its walls
weathered observatory surrounded by improvised power collectors
tram depot with sheltered workspaces between stationary carriages
abandoned apartment courtyard with a communal water pump
